name: The Creative
judgment_legge: Khien (represents) what is great and originating, penetrating, advantageous, correct and firm.
image_legge: Heaven, in its motion, (gives the idea of) strength. The superior man, in accordance with this, nerves himself to ceaseless activity.
image_zh: 天行健，君子以自强不息。
plain_en: Six solid lines: heaven, pure yang. Traditionally read as steady, self-renewing effort, like the sky that keeps turning without rest.
plain_zh: 六爻皆阳，象征天。传统上理解为持续不息、自我更新的努力，如同天体运行从不停歇。

name: The Receptive
judgment_legge: Khwăn (represents) what is great and originating, penetrating, advantageous, correct and having the firmness of a mare. When the superior man (here intended) has to make any movement, if he take the initiative, he will go astray; if he follow, he will find his (proper) lord. The advantageousness will be seen in his getting friends in the south-west, and losing friends in the north-east. If he rest in correctness and firmness, there will be good fortune.
image_legge: The (capacity and sustaining) power of the earth is what is denoted by Khwăn. The superior man, in accordance with this, with his large virtue supports (men and) things.
judgment_zh: 元亨。利牝马之贞。君子有攸往，先迷后得主。利西南得朋，东北丧朋。安贞，吉。
image_zh: 地势坤，君子以厚德载物。
plain_en: Six broken lines: earth, pure yin. It speaks of receptiveness and support, the way the ground carries everything placed on it.
plain_zh: 六爻皆阴，象征地。它讲的是包容与承载，就像大地托起万物。

name: Difficulty at the Beginning
judgment_legge: Kun (indicates that in the case which it presupposes) there will be great progress and success, and the advantage will come from being correct and firm. (But) any movement in advance should not be (lightly) undertaken. There will be advantage in appointing feudal princes.
image_legge: (The trigram representing) clouds and (that representing) thunder form Kun. The superior man, in accordance with this, (adjusts his measures of government) as in sorting the threads of the warp and woof.
judgment_zh: 元亨，利贞。勿用有攸往，利建侯。
image_zh: 云雷，屯；君子以经纶。
plain_en: Water over thunder: a sprout pushing through hard soil. The classic text pictures early-stage difficulty, when things are new and still taking shape.
plain_zh: 水在雷上，如嫩芽破土。经文描绘的是万事开头时的艰难与混沌。

name: Youthful Folly
judgment_legge: Măng (indicates that in the case which it presupposes) there will be progress and success. I do not (go and) seek the youthful and inexperienced, but he comes and seeks me. When he shows (the sincerity that marks) the first recourse to divination, I instruct him. If he apply a second and third time, that is troublesome; and I do not instruct the troublesome. There will be advantage in being firm and correct.
image_legge: (The trigram representing) a mountain, and beneath it that for a spring issuing forth form Măng. The superior man, in accordance with this, strives to be resolute in his conduct and nourishes his virtue.
judgment_zh: 亨。匪我求童蒙，童蒙求我。初筮告，再三渎，渎则不告。利贞。
image_zh: 山下出泉，蒙；君子以果行育德。
plain_en: A spring at the foot of a mountain. The theme is learning: the young student who asks, and the teacher who answers when asked sincerely.
plain_zh: 山下出泉。主题是启蒙求学：童蒙来问，师者在真诚求教时回答。

name: Waiting
judgment_legge: Hsü intimates that, with the sincerity which is declared in it, there will be brilliant success. With firmness there will be good fortune; and it will be advantageous to cross the great stream.
image_legge: (The trigram for) clouds ascending over that for the sky forms Hsü. The superior man, in accordance with this, eats and drinks, feasts and enjoys himself (as if there were nothing else to employ him).
judgment_zh: 有孚，光亨。贞吉，利涉大川。
image_zh: 云上于天，需；君子以饮食宴乐。
plain_en: Clouds gather above heaven before rain. The text is about patient waiting, eating and drinking calmly while the time ripens.
plain_zh: 云上于天，雨将至而未至。讲的是耐心等待，从容饮食，静候时机成熟。

name: Conflict
judgment_legge: Sung intimates how, though there is sincerity in one's contention, he will yet meet with opposition and obstruction; but if he cherish an apprehensive caution, there will be good fortune, while, if he must prosecute the contention to the (bitter) end, there will be evil. It will be advantageous to see the great man; it will not be advantageous to cross the great stream.
image_legge: (The trigram representing) heaven and (that representing) water, moving away from each other, form Sung. The superior man, in accordance with this, in the transaction of affairs takes good counsel about his first steps.
judgment_zh: 有孚，窒，惕，中吉，终凶。利见大人，不利涉大川。
image_zh: 天与水违行，讼；君子以作事谋始。
plain_en: Heaven and water move in opposite directions. The classic describes a dispute and advises stopping halfway rather than pressing it to the end.
plain_zh: 天与水相背而行。经文描述争讼，主张适可而止，不宜争到底。

name: The Army
judgment_legge: Sze indicates how, in the case which it supposes, with firmness and correctness, and (a leader of) age and experience, there will be good fortune and no error.
image_legge: (The trigram representing) the earth and in the midst of it that representing water, form Sze. The superior man, in accordance with this, nourishes and educates the people, and collects (from among them) the multitudes (of the hosts).
image_zh: 地中有水，师；君子以容民畜众。
plain_en: Water hidden within the earth, like soldiers among the people. It discusses organisation and discipline under an experienced leader.
plain_zh: 地中有水，如兵藏于民。讲的是组织、纪律与有经验的统领。

name: Holding Together
judgment_legge: Pî indicates that (under the conditions which it supposes) there is good fortune. But let (the principal party intended in it) re-examine himself, (as if) by divination, whether his virtue be great, unintermitting, and firm. If it be so, there will be no error. Those who have not rest will then come to him; and with those who are (too) late in coming it will be ill.
image_legge: (The trigram representing) the earth, and over it (that representing) water, form Pî. The ancient kings, in accordance with this, established the various states and maintained an affectionate relation to their princes.
judgment_zh: 吉。原筮元永贞，无咎。不宁方来，后夫凶。
image_zh: 地上有水，比；先王以建万国，亲诸侯。
plain_en: Water lying on the earth, closely joined. The image is of people drawing together around a shared centre.
plain_zh: 地上有水，紧密相依。描绘的是众人围绕共同中心彼此亲附。

name: The Taming Power of the Small
judgment_legge: Hsiâo Khû indicates that (under its conditions) there will be progress and success. (We see) dense clouds, but no rain coming from our borders in the west.
image_legge: (The trigram representing) the sky, and that representing wind moving above it, form Hsiâo Khû The superior man, in accordance with this, adorns the outward manifestation of his virtue.
image_zh: 风行天上，小畜，君子以懿文德。
plain_en: Wind drifting across the sky, dense clouds but no rain yet. A small force gently restrains a larger one; progress comes in small steps.
plain_zh: 风行天上，密云不雨。以小畜大，进展是一点点积累而来的。

name: Treading
judgment_legge: (Lî suggests the idea of) one treading on the tail of a tiger, which does not bite him. There will be progress and success.
image_legge: (The trigram representing) the sky above, and below it (that representing the waters of) a marsh, form Lî. The superior man, in accordance with this, discriminates between high and low, and gives settlement to the aims of the people.
image_zh: 上天下泽，履；君子以辨上下，定民志。
plain_en: Heaven above a lake. The text uses the picture of stepping on a tiger's tail to talk about careful, courteous conduct.
plain_zh: 上天下泽。经文以“履虎尾”为喻，讲审慎而有礼的行为。

name: Peace
judgment_legge: In Thâi (we see) the little gone and the great come. (It indicates that) there will be good fortune, with progress and success.
image_legge: (The trigrams for) heaven and earth in communication together form Thâi. The (sage) sovereign, in harmony with this, fashions and completes (his regulations) after the courses of heaven and earth, and assists the application of the adaptations furnished by them,--in order to benefit the people.
image_zh: 天地交，泰；后以财成天地之道，辅相天地之宜，以左右民。
plain_en: Earth above, heaven below: the two meet and communicate. Classical readers saw it as a picture of harmony and flow between high and low.
plain_zh: 地在上，天在下，天地交而相通。古人视之为上下和谐、彼此通达的图景。

name: Standstill
judgment_legge: In Phî there is the want of good understanding between the (different classes of) men, and its indication is unfavourable to the firm and correct course of the superior man. We see in it the great gone and the little come.
image_legge: (The trigrams of) heaven and earth, not in intercommunication, form Phî. The superior man, in accordance with this, restrains (the manifestation) of) his virtue, and avoids the calamities (that threaten him). There is no opportunity of conferring on him the glory of emolument.
judgment_zh: 否之匪人，不利君子贞，大往小来。
image_zh: 天地不交，否；君子以俭德辟难，不可荣以禄。
plain_en: Heaven above, earth below, drawing apart. It depicts a time when communication stalls and the text advises quiet integrity.
plain_zh: 天在上，地在下，彼此不交。描绘沟通阻塞的时期，经文主张守住本心、低调自处。

name: Fellowship with Men
judgment_legge: Thung Zăn (or 'Union of men') appears here (as we find it) in the (remote districts of the) country, indicating progress and success. It will be advantageous to cross the great stream. It will be advantageous to maintain the firm correctness of the superior man.
image_legge: (The trigrams for) heaven and fire form Thung Zăn. The superior man, in accordance with this), distinguishes things according to their kinds and classes.
judgment_zh: 同人于野，亨。利涉大川，利君子贞。
image_zh: 天与火，同人；君子以类族辨物。
plain_en: Heaven over fire, both rising together. It concerns fellowship that reaches openly beyond one's own circle.
plain_zh: 天与火同向上。讲的是坦荡地走出小圈子、与人同心。

name: Possession in Great Measure
judgment_legge: Tâ Yû indicates that, (under the circumstances which it implies), there will be great progress and success.
image_legge: (The trigram for) heaven and (that of) fire above it form Tâ Yû The superior man, in accordance with this, represses what is evil and gives distinction to what is good, in sympathy with the excellent Heaven-conferred (nature).
image_zh: 火在天上，大有；君子以遏恶扬善，顺天休命。
plain_en: Fire high in heaven, shining on everything. It portrays great abundance held with modesty and fairness.
plain_zh: 火在天上，普照万物。描绘丰盛之时，以谦和公正持守。

name: Modesty
judgment_legge: Khien indicates progress and success. The superior man, (being humble as it implies), will have a (good) issue (to his undertakings).
image_legge: (The trigram for) the earth and (that of) a mountain in the midst of it form Khien. The superior man, in accordance with this, diminishes what is excessive (in himself), and increases where there is any defect, bringing about an equality, according to the nature of the case, in his treatment (of himself and others).
image_zh: 地中有山，谦；君子以裒多益寡，称物平施。
plain_en: A mountain hidden inside the earth. The classic praises modesty: the high making itself low, which the text says carries things through.
plain_zh: 地中有山，高者自处于下。经文推崇谦逊，认为谦能使事情善始善终。

name: Enthusiasm
judgment_legge: Yü indicates that, (in the state which it implies), feudal princes may be set up, and the hosts put in motion, with advantage.
image_legge: (The trigrams for) the earth and thunder issuing from it with its crashing noise form Yü. The ancient kings, in accordance with this, composed their music and did honour to virtue, presenting it especially and most grandly to God, when they associated with Him (at the service) their highest ancestor and their father.
image_zh: 雷出地奋，豫。先王以作乐崇德，殷荐之上帝，以配祖考。
plain_en: Thunder bursting from the earth. Ancient readers linked it with music, enthusiasm and preparing ahead.
plain_zh: 雷出地奋。古人将其与音乐、喜乐和预先准备联系在一起。

name: Following
judgment_legge: Sui indicates that (under its conditions) there will be great progress and success. But it will be advantageous to be firm and correct. There will (then) be no error.
image_legge: (The trigram for the waters of) a marsh and (that for) thunder (hidden) in the midst of it form Sui. The superior man in accordance with this, when it is getting towards dark, enters (his house) and rests.
image_zh: 泽中有雷，随；君子以向晦入宴息。
plain_en: Thunder resting in the lake. It is about following and adapting to the time, and resting when evening comes.
plain_zh: 泽中有雷。讲的是随顺时势、顺应变化，到了傍晚就休息。

name: Work on What Has Been Spoiled
judgment_legge: Kû indicates great progress and success (to him who deals properly with the condition represented by it). There will be advantage in (efforts like that of) crossing the great stream. (He should weigh well, however, the events of) three days before the turning point, and those (to be done) three days after it.
image_legge: (The trigram for) a mountain, and below it that for wind, form Kû. The superior man, in accordance with this, (addresses himself to) help the people and nourish his own virtue.
judgment_zh: 元亨。利涉大川。先甲三日，后甲三日。
image_zh: 山下有风，蛊；君子以振民育德。
plain_en: Wind blowing low under a mountain, where things stagnate. The text speaks of repairing what has decayed, especially inherited problems.
plain_zh: 山下有风，气流不畅。经文讲整治积弊，尤其是前人留下的问题。

name: Approach
judgment_legge: Lin (indicates that under the conditions supposed in it) there will be great progress and success, while it will be advantageous to be firmly correct. In the eighth month there will be evil.
image_legge: (The trigram for) the waters of a marsh and that for the earth above it form Lin. The superior man, in accordance with this, has his purposes of instruction that are inexhaustible, and nourishes and supports the people without limit.
judgment_zh: 元亨。利贞。至于八月有凶。
image_zh: 泽上有地，临；君子以教思无穷，容保民无疆。
plain_en: Earth over a lake, the shore drawing near the water. It describes approaching others and overseeing with care.
plain_zh: 泽上有地，岸临于水。描述亲临、关照与督导。

name: Contemplation
judgment_legge: Kwân shows (how he whom it represents should be like) the worshipper who has washed his hands, but not (yet) presented his offerings;--with sincerity and an appearance of dignity (commanding reverent regard).
image_legge: (The trigram representing) the earth, and that for wind moving above it, form Kwan. The ancient kings, in accordance with this, examined the (different) regions (of the kingdom), to see the (ways of the) people, and set forth their instructions.
image_zh: 风行地上，观；先王以省方，观民设教。
plain_en: Wind moving over the earth. It is about looking carefully and also being seen, like a ceremony watched by all.
plain_zh: 风行地上。讲观察，也讲被观察，如同众人瞻仰的典礼。

name: Biting Through
judgment_legge: Shih Ho indicates successful progress (in the condition of things which it supposes). It will be advantageous to use legal constraints.
image_legge: (The trigrams representing) thunder and lightning form Shih Ho. The ancient kings, in accordance with this, framed their penalties with intelligence, and promulgated their laws.
image_zh: 雷电噬嗑；先王以明罚敕法。
plain_en: Fire and thunder: lightning and a decisive bite. The image is clearing an obstacle by firm, fair judgement.
plain_zh: 雷电交加，如咬合之口。意象是以果断公正清除阻碍。

name: Grace
judgment_legge: Pî indicates that there should be free course (in what it denotes). There will be little advantage (however) if it be allowed to advance (and take the lead).
image_legge: (The trigram representing) a mountain and that for fire under it form Pî. The superior man, in accordance with this, throws a brilliancy around his various processes of government, but does not dare (in a similar way) to decide cases of criminal litigation.
image_zh: 山下有火，贲；君子以明庶政，无敢折狱。
plain_en: Fire at the foot of a mountain lighting it up. It discusses adornment and beauty, and their proper, modest place.
plain_zh: 山下有火，照亮山色。讨论文饰与美，以及它们应有的分寸。

name: Splitting Apart
judgment_legge: Po indicates that (in the state which it symbolises) it will not be advantageous to make a movement in any direction whatever.
image_legge: (The trigrams representing) the earth, and (above it) that for a mountain, which adheres to the earth, form Po. Superiors, in accordance with this, seek to strengthen those below them, to secure the peace and stability of their own position.
image_zh: 山附地上，剥；上以厚下，安宅。
plain_en: A mountain resting on earth, its slopes wearing away. It pictures a time of erosion when holding still is wiser than acting.
plain_zh: 山附于地，渐被剥蚀。描绘衰落之时，静守比妄动更明智。

name: Return
judgment_legge: Fû indicates that there will be free course and progress (in what it denotes). (The subject of it) finds no one to distress him in his exits and entrances; friends come to him, and no error is committed. He will return and repeat his (proper) course. In seven days comes his return. There will be advantage in whatever direction movement is made.
image_legge: (The trigram representing) the earth and that for thunder in the midst of it form Fû. The ancient kings, in accordance with this, on the day of the (winter) solstice, shut the gates of the passes (from one state to another), so that the travelling merchants could not (then) pursue their journeys, nor the princes go on with the inspection of their states.
judgment_zh: 亨。出入无疾，朋来无咎。反复其道，七日来复，利有攸往。
image_zh: 雷在地中，复；先王以至日闭关，商旅不行，后不省方。
plain_en: Thunder deep within the earth: the first stirring of return. It is linked to the winter solstice, when light begins to come back.
plain_zh: 雷在地中，一阳初动。与冬至相关，象征光明开始回归。

name: Innocence
judgment_legge: Wû Wang indicates great progress and success, while there will be advantage in being firm and correct. If (its subject and his action) be not correct, he will fall into errors, and it will not be advantageous for him to move in any direction.
image_legge: The thunder rolls all under the sky, and to (every)thing there is given (its nature), free from all insincerity. The ancient kings, in accordance with this, (made their regulations) in complete accordance with the seasons, thereby nourishing all things.
judgment_zh: 元亨。利贞。其匪正有眚，不利有攸往。
image_zh: 天下雷行，物与无妄；先王以茂对时，育万物。
plain_en: Thunder rolling under heaven. It praises acting without hidden motives, natural and unforced.
plain_zh: 天下雷行。推崇不存妄念、自然真诚的行事。

name: Great Accumulation
judgment_legge: Under the conditions of Tâ Khû it will be advantageous to be firm and correct. (If its subject do not seek to) enjoy his revenues in his own family (without taking service at court), there will be good fortune. It will be advantageous for him to cross the great stream.
image_legge: (The trigram representing) a mountain, and in the midst of it that (representing) heaven, form Tâ Khû. The superior man, in accordance with this, stores largely in his memory the words and deeds of former men, to subserve the accumulation of his virtue.
judgment_zh: 利贞，不家食吉，利涉大川。
image_zh: 天在山中，大畜；君子以多识前言往行，以畜其德。
plain_en: Heaven contained within a mountain. It describes storing up strength and learning from the words and deeds of the past.
plain_zh: 天在山中。描述积蓄力量，并从前人言行中学习。

name: Corners of the Mouth
judgment_legge: Î indicates that with firm correctness there will be good fortune (in what is denoted by it). We must look at what we are seeking to nourish, and by the exercise of our thoughts seek for the proper aliment.
image_legge: (The trigram representing) a mountain and under it that for thunder form Î. The superior man, in accordance with this, (enjoins) watchfulness over our words, and the temperate regulation of our eating and drinking.
image_zh: 山下有雷，颐；君子以慎言语，节饮食。
plain_en: Thunder below a mountain, shaped like an open mouth. It is about nourishment: what we take in, and what we say.
plain_zh: 山下有雷，形如张开的口。讲颐养：吃进去的，以及说出来的。

name: Preponderance of the Great
judgment_legge: Tâ Kwo suggests to us a beam that is weak. There will be advantage in moving (under its conditions) in any direction whatever; there will be success.
image_legge: (The trigram representing) trees hidden beneath that for the waters of a marsh forms Tâ Kwo. The superior man, in accordance with this, stands up alone and has no fear, and keeps retired from the world without regret.
image_zh: 泽灭木，大过。君子以独立不惧，遯世无闷。
plain_en: A lake rising above the trees, a beam bending under weight. It describes an extraordinary load and acting with unusual resolve.
plain_zh: 泽灭木，栋梁弯曲。描述非常的重负，以及非常的担当。

name: The Abysmal
judgment_legge: Khan, here repeated, shows the possession of sincerity, through which the mind is penetrating. Action (in accordance with this) will be of high value.
image_legge: (The representation of) water flowing on continuously forms the repeated Khan. The superior man, in accordance with this, maintains constantly the virtue (of his heart) and (the integrity of) his conduct, and practises the business of instruction.
image_zh: 水洊至，习坎；君子以常德行，习教事。
plain_en: Water upon water, a gorge within a gorge. The text speaks of moving through danger by keeping one's integrity, as water keeps flowing.
plain_zh: 水上加水，险中有险。经文讲在险境中守信前行，如流水不止。

name: The Clinging
judgment_legge: Lî indicates that, (in regard to what it denotes), it will be advantageous to be firm and correct, and that thus there will be free course and success. Let (its subject) also nourish (a docility like that of) the cow, and there will be good fortune.
image_legge: (The trigram for) brightness, repeated, forms Lî. The great man, in accordance with this, cultivates more and more his brilliant (virtue), and diffuses its brightness over the four quarters (of the land).
image_zh: 明两作离，大人以继明照于四方。
plain_en: Fire upon fire, brightness doubled. It is about clarity and what light depends on, as flame clings to its fuel.
plain_zh: 火上加火，光明相继。讲明亮，也讲光明所依附之物，如火依附于柴。

name: Influence
judgment_legge: Hsien indicates that, (on the fulfilment of the conditions implied in it), there will be free course and success. Its advantageousness will depend on the being firm and correct, (as) in marrying a young lady. There will be good fortune.
image_legge: (The trigram representing) a mountain and above it that for (the waters of) a marsh form Hsien. The superior man, in accordance with this, keeps his mind free from pre-occupation, and open to receive (the influences of) others.
image_zh: 山上有泽，咸；君子以虚受人。
plain_en: A lake on a mountain, the two responding to each other. It describes mutual attraction and the openness needed to receive others.
plain_zh: 山上有泽，彼此感应。讲相互吸引，以及接纳他人所需的虚怀。

name: Duration
judgment_legge: Hăng indicates successful progress and no error (in what it denotes). But the advantage will come from being firm and correct; and movement in any direction whatever will be advantageous.
image_legge: (The trigram representing) thunder and that for wind form Hăng. The superior man, in accordance with this, stands firm, and does not change his method (of operation).
image_zh: 雷风，恒；君子以立不易方。
plain_en: Thunder and wind, always together. It speaks of constancy and endurance over time.
plain_zh: 雷与风常相伴随。讲恒久与持之以恒。

name: Retreat
judgment_legge: Thun indicates successful progress (in its circumstances). To a small extent it will (still) be advantageous to be firm and correct.
image_legge: (The trigram representing) the sky and below it that for a mountain form Thun. The superior man, in accordance with this, keeps small men at a distance, not by showing that he hates them, but by his own dignified gravity.
image_zh: 天下有山，遯；君子以远小人，不恶而严。
plain_en: A mountain under heaven, the sky receding. It is about stepping back gracefully at the right time.
plain_zh: 天下有山，天远山近。讲在适当时机从容退避。

name: Great Power
judgment_legge: Tâ Kwang indicates that (under the conditions which it symbolises) it will be advantageous to be firm and correct.
image_legge: (The trigram representing) heaven and above it that for thunder form Tâ Kwang. The superior man, in accordance with this, does not take a step which is not according to propriety.
image_zh: 雷在天上，大壮；君子以非礼弗履。
plain_en: Thunder high in heaven. It shows great strength and reminds that power should follow what is right.
plain_zh: 雷在天上。表现强大的力量，也提醒力量须合于正道。

name: Progress
judgment_legge: In Žin we see a prince who secures the tranquillity (of the people) presented on that account with numerous horses (by the king), and three times in a day received at interviews.
image_legge: (The trigram representing) the earth and that for the bright (sun) coming forth above it form Žin. The superior man, according to this, gives himself to make more brilliant his bright virtue.
judgment_zh: 康侯用锡马蕃庶，昼日三接。
image_zh: 明出地上，晋；君子以自昭明德。
plain_en: The sun rising above the earth. It pictures advancement and recognition that come in the open light of day.
plain_zh: 日出地上。描绘光明正大的晋升与受到赏识。

name: Darkening of the Light
judgment_legge: Ming Î indicates that (in the circumstances which it denotes) it will be advantageous to realise the difficulty (of the position), and maintain firm correctness.
image_legge: (The trigram representing) the earth and that for the bright (sun) entering within it form Ming Î. The superior man, in accordance with this, conducts his management of men;--he shows his intelligence by keeping it obscured.
image_zh: 明入地中，明夷；君子以莅众，用晦而明。
plain_en: The sun sunk beneath the earth. It describes keeping one's light inside during a dark time.
plain_zh: 日入地中。描述在晦暗时期内守光明、韬光养晦。

name: The Family
judgment_legge: For (the realisation of what is taught in) Kiâ Zăn, (or for the regulation of the family), what is most advantageous is that the wife be firm and correct.
image_legge: (The trigram representing) fire, and that for wind coming forth from it, form Kiâ Zăn. The superior man, in accordance with this, orders his words according to (the truth of) things, and his conduct so that it is uniformly consistent.
image_zh: 风自火出，家人；君子以言有物，而行有恒。
plain_en: Wind rising from fire, as from a hearth. It is about family roles, words with substance and steady conduct.
plain_zh: 风自火出，如炉灶生风。讲家庭中的角色、言之有物与行之有恒。

name: Opposition
judgment_legge: Khwei indicates that, (notwithstanding the condition of things which it denotes), in small matters there will (still) be good success.
image_legge: (The trigram representing) fire above, and that for (the waters of) a marsh below, form Khwei. The superior man, in accordance with this, where there is a general agreement, yet admits diversity.
image_zh: 上火下泽，睽；君子以同而异。
plain_en: Fire rises and the lake sinks: they move apart. It discusses difference and finding agreement in small things.
plain_zh: 火上泽下，背道而行。讨论差异，以及在小事上求同。

name: Obstruction
judgment_legge: In (the state indicated by) Kien advantage will be found in the south-west, and the contrary in the north-east. It will be advantageous (also) to meet with the great man. (In these circumstances), with firmness and correctness, there will be good fortune.
image_legge: (The trigram representing) a mountain, and above it that for water, form Kien. The superior man, in accordance with this, turns round (and examines) himself, and cultivates his virtue.
judgment_zh: 利西南，不利东北；利见大人，贞吉。
image_zh: 山上有水，蹇；君子以反身修德。
plain_en: Water on a mountain, a hard path ahead. The text advises pausing to reflect and seeking help when the way is blocked.
plain_zh: 山上有水，前路艰险。经文主张在受阻时停下来反省，并寻求帮助。

name: Deliverance
judgment_legge: In (the state indicated by) Kieh advantage will be found in the south-west. If no (further) operations be called for, there will be good fortune in coming back (to the old conditions). If some operations be called for, there will be good fortune in the early conducting of them.
image_legge: (The trigram representing) thunder and that for rain, with these phenomena in a state of manifestation, form Kieh. The superior man, in accordance with this, forgives errors, and deals gently with crimes.
judgment_zh: 利西南，无所往，其来复吉。有攸往，夙吉。
image_zh: 雷雨作，解；君子以赦过宥罪。
plain_en: Thunder and rain release a tension. It pictures relief after difficulty and a willingness to forgive.
plain_zh: 雷雨作，紧张得以舒解。描绘困难之后的解脱与宽宥。

name: Decrease
judgment_legge: In (what is denoted by) Sun, if there be sincerity (in him who employs it), there will be great good fortune:--freedom from error; firmness and correctness that can be maintained; and advantage in every movement that shall be made. In what shall this (sincerity in the exercise of Sun) be employed? (Even) in sacrifice two baskets of grain, (though there be nothing else), may be presented.
image_legge: (The trigram representing) a mountain and beneath it that for the waters of a marsh form Sun. The superior man, in accordance with this, restrains his wrath and represses his desires.
judgment_zh: 有孚，元吉。无咎，可贞，利有攸往。曷之用？二簋可用享。
image_zh: 山下有泽，损；君子以惩忿窒欲。
plain_en: A lake below a mountain, giving of itself. It is about decrease that is sincere and well judged, such as restraining anger and desire.
plain_zh: 山下有泽，自损以益上。讲真诚而适度的减损，比如克制忿怒与欲望。

name: Increase
judgment_legge: Yî indicates that (in the state which it denotes) there will be advantage in every movement which shall be undertaken, that it will be advantageous (even) to cross the great stream.
image_legge: (The trigram representing) wind and that for thunder form Yî. The superior man, in accordance with this, when he sees what is good, moves towards it; and when he sees his errors, he turns from them.
image_zh: 风雷，益；君子以见善则迁，有过则改。
plain_en: Wind and thunder strengthen each other. It describes increase that benefits those below and learning from good examples.
plain_zh: 风雷相助。描述惠及下层的增益，以及见善则迁。

name: Breakthrough
judgment_legge: Kwâi requires (in him who would fulfil its meaning) the exhibition (of the culprit's guilt) in the royal court, and a sincere and earnest appeal (for sympathy and support), with a consciousness of the peril (involved in cutting off the criminal). He should (also) make announcement in his own city, and show that it will not be well to have recourse at once to arms. (In this way) there will be advantage in whatever he shall go forward to.
image_legge: (The trigram representing) heaven and that for the waters of a marsh mounting above it form Kwâi. The superior man, in accordance with this, bestows emolument on those below him, and dislikes allowing his gifts to accumulate (undispensed).
judgment_zh: 扬于王庭，孚号，有厉，告自邑，不利即戎，利有攸往。
image_zh: 泽上于天，夬；君子以施禄及下，居德则忌。
plain_en: A lake risen up to heaven, about to break through. It speaks of decisive, open resolution of a problem.
plain_zh: 泽上于天，将要决口。讲公开而果断地解决问题。

name: Coming to Meet
judgment_legge: Kâu shows a female who is bold and strong. It will not be good to marry (such) a female.
image_legge: (The trigram representing) wind and that for the sky above it form Kâu. The sovereign, in accordance with this, delivers his charges, and promulgates his announcements throughout the four quarters (of the kingdom).
image_zh: 天下有风，姤；后以施命诰四方。
plain_en: Wind blowing everywhere under heaven. It describes an unexpected encounter and messages spread far and wide.
plain_zh: 天下有风。描述不期而遇，以及命令四方传布。

name: Gathering Together
judgment_legge: In (the state denoted by) Žhui, the king will repair to his ancestral temple. It will be advantageous (also) to meet with the great man; and then there will be progress and success, though the advantage must come through firm correctness. The use of great victims will conduce to good fortune; and in whatever direction movement is made, it will be advantageous.
image_legge: (The trigram representing the) earth and that for the waters of a marsh raised above it form Žhui. The superior man, in accordance with this, has his weapons of war put in good repair, to be prepared against unforeseen contingencies.
judgment_zh: 王假有庙，利见大人，亨。利贞。用大牲吉，利有攸往。
image_zh: 泽上于地，萃；君子以除戎器，戒不虞。
plain_en: A lake gathered on the earth. It is about people assembling and being prepared for the unexpected.
plain_zh: 泽上于地。讲众人聚集，以及防备不测。

name: Pushing Upward
judgment_legge: Shăng indicates that (under its conditions) there will be great progress and success. Seeking by (the qualities implied in it) to meet with the great man, its subject need have no anxiety. Advance to the south will be fortunate.
image_legge: (The trigram representing) wood and that for the earth with the wood growing in the midst of it form Shăng. The superior man, in accordance with this, pays careful attention to his virtue, and accumulates the small developments of it till it is high and great.
judgment_zh: 元亨，用见大人，勿恤，南征吉。
image_zh: 地中生木，升；君子以顺德，积小以高大。
plain_en: A tree growing up from within the earth. It pictures steady upward growth, small things accumulating into something tall.
plain_zh: 地中生木。描绘稳步上升，积小以成高大。

name: Oppression
judgment_legge: In (the condition denoted by) Khwăn there may (yet be) progress and success. For the firm and correct, the (really) great man, there will be good fortune. He will fall into no error. If he make speeches, his words cannot be made good.
image_legge: (The trigram representing) a marsh, and (below it that for a defile, which has drained the other dry so that there is) no water in it, form Khwăn. The superior man, in accordance with this, will sacrifice his life in order to carry out his purpose.
judgment_zh: 亨，贞大人吉，无咎，有言不信。
image_zh: 泽无水，困；君子以致命遂志。
plain_en: A lake with no water left in it. It describes exhaustion and constraint, and staying true to one's aim despite them.
plain_zh: 泽中无水。描述困顿与受限，以及身处其中仍坚守志向。

name: The Well
judgment_legge: (Looking at) Žing, (we think of) how (the site of) a town may be changed, while (the fashion of) its wells undergoes no change. (The water of a well) never disappears and never receives (any great) increase, and those who come and those who go can draw and enjoy the benefit. If (the drawing) have nearly been accomplished, but, before the rope has quite reached the water, the bucket is broken, this is evil.
image_legge: (The trigram representing) wood and above it that for water form Žing. The superior man, in accordance with this, comforts the people, and stimulates them to mutual helpfulness.
judgment_zh: 改邑不改井，无丧无得，往来井井。汔至亦未繘井。羸其瓶，凶。
image_zh: 木上有水，井；君子以劳民劝相。
plain_en: Water drawn up by wood: a well. The well serves everyone and stays in place while towns change around it.
plain_zh: 木上有水，汲水为井。井供养众人，城邑可迁而井不可移。

name: Revolution
judgment_legge: (What takes place as indicated by) Ko is believed in only after it has been accomplished. There will be great progress and success. Advantage will come from being firm and correct. (In that case) occasion for repentance will disappear.
image_legge: (The trigram representing the waters of) a marsh and that for fire in the midst of them form Ko. The superior man, in accordance with this, regulates his (astronomical) calculations, and makes clear the seasons and times.
judgment_zh: 已日乃孚，元亨。利贞。悔亡。
image_zh: 泽中有火，革；君子以治历明时。
plain_en: Fire inside a lake, one transforming the other. It concerns change carried out at the right time, like a calendar adjusted to the seasons.
plain_zh: 泽中有火，相互变革。讲适时的变革，如依四时修订历法。

name: The Cauldron
judgment_legge: Ting gives the intimation of great progress and success.
image_legge: (The trigram representing) wood and above it that for fire form Ting. The superior man, in accordance with this, keeps his every position correct, and maintains secure the appointment (of Heaven).
image_zh: 木上有火，鼎；君子以正位凝命。
plain_en: Fire beneath wood: a ritual cauldron cooking food. It stands for nourishing others and settling into one's proper role.
plain_zh: 木上有火，鼎中烹煮。象征养贤养人，以及安于正位。

name: Thunder
judgment_legge: Kăn gives the intimation of ease and development. When (the time of) movement (which it indicates) comes, (the subject of the hexagram) will be found looking out with apprehension, and yet smiling and talking cheerfully. When the movement (like a crash of thunder) terrifies all within a hundred lî, he will be (like the sincere worshipper) who is not (startled into) letting go his ladle and (cup of) sacrificial spirits.
image_legge: (The trigram representing) thunder, being repeated, forms Kăn. The superior man, in accordance with this, is fearful and apprehensive, cultivates (his virtue), and examines (his faults).
judgment_zh: 亨。震来虩虩，笑言哑哑。震惊百里，不丧匕鬯。
image_zh: 洊雷，震；君子以恐惧修省。
plain_en: Thunder upon thunder. It is about shock and the calm, reflective response that can follow fear.
plain_zh: 雷上加雷。讲震动，以及恐惧之后冷静的反省。

name: Mountain
judgment_legge: When one's resting is like that of the back, and he loses all consciousness of self; when he walks in his courtyard, and does not see any (of the persons) in it,--there will be no error.
image_legge: (Two trigrams representing) a mountain, one over the other, form Kăn. The superior man, in 0 accordance with this, does not go in his thoughts beyond the (duties of the) position in which he is.
judgment_zh: 艮其背，不获其身，行其庭，不见其人，无咎。
image_zh: 兼山，艮；君子以思不出其位。
plain_en: Mountain upon mountain. It is about stillness: stopping when it is time to stop, thoughts staying within their place.
plain_zh: 山上加山。讲静止：当止则止，思虑不越出其位。

name: Gradual Development
judgment_legge: Kien suggests to us the marriage of a young lady, and the good fortune (attending it). There will be advantage in being firm and correct.
image_legge: (The trigram representing) a mountain and above it that for a tree form Kien. The superior man, in accordance with this, attains to and maintains his extraordinary virtue, and makes the manners of the people good.
image_zh: 山上有木，渐；君子以居贤德，善俗。
plain_en: A tree on a mountain, growing slowly. It describes gradual development, like a wild goose advancing step by step.
plain_zh: 山上有木，缓慢生长。描述循序渐进，如鸿雁一步步前行。

name: The Marrying Girl
judgment_legge: Kwei Mei indicates that (under the conditions which it denotes) action will be evil, and in no wise advantageous.
image_legge: (The trigram representing the waters of) a marsh and over it that for thunder form Kwei Mei. The superior man, in accordance with this, having regard to the far-distant end, knows the mischief (that may be done at the beginning).
image_zh: 泽上有雷，归妹；君子以永终知敝。
plain_en: Thunder over a lake. It uses an old marriage custom to discuss a subordinate position and thinking about how things end.
plain_zh: 泽上有雷。借古代婚俗讨论从属的处境，以及要顾及事情的结局。

name: Abundance
judgment_legge: Făng intimates progress and development. When a king has reached the point (which the name denotes) there is no occasion to be anxious (through fear of a change). Let him be as the sun at noon.
image_legge: (The trigrams representing) thunder and lightning combine to form Făng. The superior man, in accordance with this, decides cases of litigation, and apportions punishments with exactness.
image_zh: 雷电皆至，丰；君子以折狱致刑。
plain_en: Thunder and lightning arrive together. It depicts a peak of abundance, like the sun at noon, which cannot last forever.
plain_zh: 雷电皆至。描绘丰盛的顶点，如日中天，但不会永久。

name: The Wanderer
judgment_legge: Lü intimates that (in the condition which it denotes) there may be some little attainment and progress. If the stranger or traveller be firm and correct as he ought to be, there will be good fortune.
image_legge: (The trigram representing) a mountain and above it that for fire form Lü. The superior man, in accordance with this, exerts his wisdom and caution in the use of punishments and not allowing litigations to continue.
image_zh: 山上有火，旅；君子以明慎用刑，而不留狱。
plain_en: Fire on a mountain, moving on. It describes the traveller, who does well by being modest and careful away from home.
plain_zh: 山上有火，火势游移。描述旅人，在外谦和谨慎方能顺利。

name: The Gentle
judgment_legge: Sun intimates that (under the conditions which it denotes) there will be some little attainment and progress. There will be advantage in movement onward in whatever direction. It will be advantageous (also) to see the great man.
image_legge: (Two trigrams representing) wind, following each other, form Sun. The superior man, in accordance with this, reiterates his orders, and secures the practice of his affairs.
judgment_zh: 小亨。利有攸往。利见大人。
image_zh: 随风，巽；君子以申命行事。
plain_en: Wind following wind. It speaks of gentle, penetrating influence and repeating instructions clearly.
plain_zh: 随风，风风相随。讲温和而深入的影响，以及反复申明命令。

name: The Joyous
judgment_legge: Tui intimates that (under its conditions) there will be progress and attainment. (But) it will be advantageous to be firm and correct.
image_legge: (Two symbols representing) the waters of a marsh, one over the other, form Tui. The superior man, in accordance with this, (encourages) the conversation of friends and (the stimulus of) their (common) practice.
image_zh: 丽泽，兑；君子以朋友讲习。
plain_en: Lake upon lake. It is about joy and the pleasure of learning with friends.
plain_zh: 两泽相连。讲喜悦，以及与朋友讲习的乐趣。

name: Dispersion
judgment_legge: Hwân intimates that (under its conditions) there will be progress and success. The king goes to his ancestral temple; and it will be advantageous to cross the great stream. It will be advantageous to be firm and correct.
image_legge: (The trigram representing) water and that for wind moving above the water form Hwân. The ancient kings, in accordance with this, presented offerings to God and established the ancestral temple.
judgment_zh: 亨，王假有庙，利涉大川，利贞。
image_zh: 风行水上，涣；先王以享于帝立庙。
plain_en: Wind moving over water, scattering it. It pictures dispersal and bringing people back together, as at a temple gathering.
plain_zh: 风行水上，水波离散。描绘涣散，以及重新凝聚人心，如在宗庙相聚。

name: Limitation
judgment_legge: Kieh intimates that (under its conditions) there will be progress and attainment. (But) if the regulations (which it prescribes) be severe and difficult, they cannot be permanent.
image_legge: (The trigram representing) a lake, and above it that for water, form Kieh. The superior man, in accordance with this, constructs his (methods of) numbering and measurement, and discusses (points of) virtue and conduct.
image_zh: 泽上有水，节；君子以制数度，议德行。
plain_en: A lake with water held in by its banks. It concerns limits and measure, and warns that limits should not be too harsh.
plain_zh: 泽上有水，堤岸节制。讲节制与分寸，也提醒节制不可过苦。

name: Inner Truth
judgment_legge: Kung Fû (moves even) pigs and fish, and leads to good fortune. There will be advantage in crossing the great stream. There will be advantage in being firm and correct.
image_legge: (The trigram representing the waters of) a marsh and that for wind above it form Kung Fû. The superior man, in accordance with this, deliberates about cases of litigation and delays (the infliction of) death.
image_zh: 泽上有风，中孚；君子以议狱缓死。
plain_en: Wind over a lake, stirring it from within. It is about inner sincerity, which the text says can move even pigs and fish.
plain_zh: 泽上有风，从内部吹动水面。讲内心的诚信，经文说其诚可以感动豚鱼。

name: Small Exceeding
judgment_legge: Hsiâo Kwo indicates that (in the circumstances which it implies) there will be progress and attainment. But it will be advantageous to be firm and correct. (What the name denotes) may be done in small affairs, but not in great affairs. (It is like) the notes that come down from a bird on the wing;--to descend is better than to ascend. There will (in this way) be great good fortune.
image_legge: (The trigram representing) a hill and that for thunder above it form Hsiâo Kwo. The superior man, in accordance with this, in his conduct exceeds in humility, in mourning exceeds in sorrow, and in his expenditure exceeds in economy.
judgment_zh: 亨。利贞。可小事，不可大事。飞鸟遗之音，不宜上宜下，大吉。
image_zh: 山上有雷，小过；君子以行过乎恭，丧过乎哀，用过乎俭。
plain_en: Thunder over a mountain, a bird flying low. It advises small, careful steps rather than reaching too high.
plain_zh: 山上有雷，飞鸟宜下不宜上。主张小心谨慎，不宜好高骛远。

name: After Completion
judgment_legge: Kî Žî intimates progress and success in small matters. There will be advantage in being firm and correct. There has been good fortune in the beginning; there may be disorder in the end.
image_legge: (The trigram representing) fire and that for water above it form Kî Žî. The superior man, in accordance with this, thinks of evil (that may come), and beforehand guards against it.
image_zh: 水在火上，既济；君子以思患而豫防之。
plain_en: Water above fire, each in its place. It depicts something completed and the care needed to keep it from falling apart.
plain_zh: 水在火上，各得其位。描绘事情已成，以及防止由盛转衰所需的谨慎。

name: Before Completion
judgment_legge: Wei Žî intimates progress and success (in the circumstances which it implies). (We see) a young fox that has nearly crossed (the stream), when its tail gets immersed. There will be no advantage in any way.
image_legge: (The trigram representing) water and that for fire above it form Wei Žî. The superior man, in accordance with this, carefully discriminates among (the qualities of) things, and the (different) positions they (naturally) occupy.
judgment_zh: 亨。小狐汔济，濡其尾，无攸利。
image_zh: 火在水上，未济；君子以慎辨物居方。
plain_en: Fire above water, not yet in place. The last hexagram describes a task not yet finished, like a young fox nearly across the river.
plain_zh: 火在水上，尚未各得其位。最后一卦描述事未完成，如小狐将要渡过河流。
